name: pixellab_animate
description:
Create or edit PIXEL ART ANIMATIONS (walk cycles, attacks, VFX) via Pixel Lab. Async ops return a job_id (use wait_seconds or pixellab_poll). Frames import to assets/pixellab/animations/. Provide frame/reference images via "image_inputs" (field → project path, auto base64); other fields go in "params".

REQUIRED FIELDS PER OPERATION:
- animate_text_v3 (RECOMMENDED, image-to-animation): image_inputs.first_frame (required) + params.action (required text, e.g. "walk", "swing sword"). Optional image_inputs.last_frame, params.frame_count (default 8), no_background. NOTE: there is NO description field here — use params.action.
- animate_text (v1): top-level description + params.action (required) + params.image_size {width,height} (required) + image_inputs.reference_image (required). Optional n_frames (default 4), view, direction.
- animate_skeleton: params.image_size (required) + image_inputs.reference_image (required) + params.skeleton_keypoints.
- interpolation_v2 / edit_animation_v2 / transfer_outfit_v2 / estimate_skeleton: provide the frames/sheet they operate on via image_inputs.
Pass an existing character's animation via pixellab_generate operation=character_animation with character_id instead.

description.description: Prompt / action description where the endpoint accepts one.

params.description: Other request fields (action, frame_count, seed, no_background, enhance_prompt, etc.).

image_inputs.description: Map of API image field → project path (e.g. {"first_frame":"a.png","last_frame":"b.png"}).

wait_seconds.description: Block and poll up to N seconds (default 0).
